name: Crónánach
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Crónánach is a hero of the Irish Fenian tale. His face carried no beauty, yet his piping was superb. At dawn his features became handsome, fit to pass as a king.

okr.objective: Crónánach is an Otherworld piper whose plain face hides a king's looks.
key_results: He pipes with great skill despite an ugly cast.
Morning light turns him into a handsome man.
His story comes from the Fenian Cycle.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
